_note: Every dependency in every manifest, with the one line that says why no existing one serves. test/dependency-guard.test.js fails on a dependency that is not here; read ALLOWED-NEW.md before adding one.

package.json.@noble/ciphers: AES-GCM for the one sealing format (lib/databox.js) that runs unchanged on the server, the phone and the browser; node:crypto cannot run on the phone
package.json.@noble/curves: P-256 and X25519 key agreement in files shared with the phone (lib/keywrap.js, relay/client); node:crypto cannot run on the phone
package.json.@noble/hashes: sha256, hmac, hkdf in files shared with the phone and browser (databox, keywrap, kernel canonical JSON)
package.json.docxtemplater: fills a Word template's placeholders (Documents, R032-01): Word splits one placeholder across runs of text and nothing else here reads .docx; MIT
package.json.pizzip: reads and writes the .docx zip for docxtemplater, with fixed dates so the same input gives the same bytes; node has no zip of its own
package.json.yaml: reads a YAML API description for the connector import; nothing else parses YAML (loaded only then, records/connectors/import-spec.js)

tools/wrangler/package.json.wrangler: deploys and runs the two Cloudflare Workers (names, relay) from a lockfile; the only Workers tool

apps/app/package.json.@dnd-kit/core: drag between board columns on the web build; the phone uses gesture-handler (revisit with a native board)
apps/app/package.json.@noble/ciphers: pinned equal to the root: metro cannot see the root node_modules
apps/app/package.json.@noble/curves: pinned equal to the root: metro cannot see the root node_modules
apps/app/package.json.@noble/hashes: pinned equal to the root: metro cannot see the root node_modules
apps/app/package.json.@rn-primitives/portal: portal the dialog and menu need
apps/app/package.json.@tanstack/react-table: headless table logic for the data views
apps/app/package.json.tailwindcss: the design tokens and classes nativewind compiles
apps/app/package.json.nativewind: tailwind classes on React Native and web
apps/app/package.json.expo-camera: scan a pairing QR on iOS (Android uses modules/vyre-scan)
apps/app/package.json.expo-document-picker: choose a password export from Files on a phone (nothing else in the app opens the system file picker)
apps/app/package.json.expo-local-authentication: Face ID and fingerprint for the one yes
apps/app/package.json.expo-secure-store: keeps keys in the Keychain and Keystore
apps/app/package.json.expo-web-browser: the system authentication browser for sign-in
apps/app/package.json.react: the UI library the whole app is written in
apps/app/package.json.react-native-web: React Native on the web build
apps/app/package.json.react-native-webview: the terminal and the Wink scan page on the phone (the web build uses an iframe)
apps/app/package.json.zustand: UI state stores (the data mirror is apps/app/src/store-core)
apps/app/package.json.@types/react: type definitions for the TypeScript checks
apps/app/package.json.babel-preset-expo: the Babel preset the Expo build needs
apps/app/package.json.typescript: the type checker for the app's .ts and .tsx files

ci:workflows.playwright: drives the app and the screenshots in CI; installed per run with no lockfile, so it is listed here
ci:workflows.@puppeteer/browsers: downloads a pinned Chrome for the browser checks (it is a downloader, not a driver)
ci:workflows.@anthropic-ai/claude-code: the provider CLI the proofs run against
ci:workflows.@openai/codex: the provider CLI the proofs run against
ci:workflows.@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp: Codex's ACP adapter for the proofs
ci:workflows.@zed-industries/codex-acp: the adapter's former name, tried when the new one is missing
ci:workflows.@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk: the SDK the sessions proof compares against
ci:workflows.@openai/codex-linux-x64: the platform binary Codex ships separately; the wire proof installs it beside the CLI

box/Dockerfile.@anthropic-ai/claude-code: a provider CLI in the box image (pinned by CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION)
box/Dockerfile.@openai/codex: a provider CLI in the box image (pinned)
box/Dockerfile.image:golang:1.27-bookworm: builds the Go Wink forwarder (pinned by digest)

core/computers/image/Dockerfile.image:debian:bookworm-slim: the computers image base (pinned by digest)

wink/forwarder/go.mod.tailscale.com: the userspace WireGuard node library under the built-in network (Wink); the only network library

local/capsule/native-win/Cargo.toml.ed25519-dalek: signs for the Windows capsule; shares test vectors with the JS
local/capsule/native-win/Cargo.toml.base64: encodes bytes in the Windows capsule
local/capsule/native-win/Cargo.toml.serde_json: JSON for the Windows app and capsule

local/capsule/native-win/app/Cargo.toml.tauri-plugin-notification: operating-system notifications for the Windows capsule
local/capsule/native-win/app/Cargo.toml.base64: encodes bytes in the Windows capsule
local/capsule/native-win/app/Cargo.toml.sha2: hashing, held to the JS by shared test vectors
local/capsule/native-win/app/Cargo.toml.serde_json: JSON for the Windows app and capsule
local/capsule/native-win/app/Cargo.toml.url: parses deep links in the Windows capsule
local/capsule/native-win/app/Cargo.toml.vyre-capsule-win: the shared Windows crate in this repo

core/daemon/native-win/Cargo.toml.windows: the Windows service and keystore calls

apps/app/modules/vault-android/android/b.androidx.biometric:biometric: fingerprint prompt for the one yes

modules/vault-android/android/build.grad.androidx.biometric:biometric: fingerprint prompt for the one yes

apps/app/modules/vyre-signer/android/bui.androidx.biometric:biometric: fingerprint prompt for the one yes

undeclaredImports.puppeteer: drives Chrome inside the pinned puppeteer image for the app-module probe (core/appmods/browser-probe.cjs); Playwright is the test driver, so this is one to retire
undeclaredImports.@huggingface/transformers: the local embedding model recall downloads on first use (core/recall/embed.js, pinned RANGE); optional
